items.headline: Real-time voice interactions are coming to Copilot podcasts
items.summary: Microsoft introduces real-time voice interactions in the Podcast feature, allowing users to speak to the presenter and clarify, explore, or dive deeper into content. Users can talk to Copilot, interrupt naturally, and get real-time spoken responses grounded in work and web data. The feature is now available in Copilot on Windows with Hey Copilot voice activation.

items.headline: Salesforce Summer 26 rolls out multi-agent orchestration and Tableau MCP integration
items.summary: Salesforce Summer 26 release goes live June 15, 2026, introducing Agentforce Multi-Agent Orchestration enabling multiple AI agents to work as a unified team sharing context across channels. Tableau MCP integration allows Agentforce agents to query Tableau analytics engine directly via Model Context Protocol, protected by the Agentforce Trust Layer. Agentforce ARR reached 800 million, up 169 percent year over year.

items.headline: Clinomic AI assistant Mona delivers 68 percent reduction in ICU documentation errors across 40 hospitals
items.summary: Clinomic's Mona AI assistant deployed across 40 hospitals in 8 EU countries achieved 68 percent reduction in documentation errors and 33 percent reduction in perceived workload for ICU healthcare staff. The platform delivers 550 hours of time savings per year per bed, 143 percent increase in patient care capacity, and 26 percent reduction in hospital transfers. Through natural language processing, Mona converts spoken observations into clinical notes, cutting documentation time up to 80 percent.

Mona validates the commercial viability of AI-powered clinical documentation with real numbers. This case study is sales enablement content for healthcare prospects and should be referenced in conversations about our medical record indexing and summarization services. The 68 percent error reduction metric directly supports our value proposition for quality and compliance.

items.headline: KPMG pulls agentic AI report after hallucination claims surface on June 13
items.summary: KPMG withdrew its report titled Redefining excellence in the age of agentic AI on June 13, 2026, after multiple organizations including UBS, NHS, Swiss Federal Railways, and Transport for London disputed claims about their AI deployments. GPTZero found only 5 of 45 citations matched real sources, with 40 titles fabricated. KPMG said it removed the report while conducting its own investigation into responsible use of AI and human oversight.

items.headline: EU AI Act high-risk deadline deferred from August 2026 to December 2027 via Digital Omnibus amendment
items.summary: European Parliament approved the Digital Omnibus on AI on June 16, 2026, by 423 votes to 57, deferring the high-risk AI systems compliance deadline from August 2, 2026, to December 2, 2027, for standalone systems in Annex III. High-risk AI embedded in products listed in Annex I moves from August 2027 to August 2028. Article 50 transparency obligations still apply from August 2, 2026, except provider watermarking which moves to December 2026. Council expected to formally adopt June 29, 2026.
